0.0: Oh, I didn't introduce myself. I'm #bHuckle#k. I'm a scholar, researching this strange, self-moving stone. The #rSentinels#k typically appear in this tower. I should hurry back, since Moppie is waiting for me, but I can't do that. I don't have enough samples.
0.1: Hey, you've been good to Moppie. Could you do me one other favor?

yes.0: Go to the tower, take down the monsters, and collect the pieces we need. #b20 #t4000083#, 20 #t4000063#, and 20 #t4000085# items#k should be enough. Oh, you won't need to check in here afterwards. I'll contact you, and I'll have my invention ready.

no.0: I see you're busy... Hmm, my Moppie must be lonely without me...

yes.0: Ohhh... This really is everything I asked for! I have a good eye for people, it seems. Anyway, I really appreciate everything you've done for me. Well, I shouldn't keep Moppie waiting any longer.
yes.1: Oh, wait! Before you go, I have one more thing to say.

item.0: I'm still waiting, you know. Defeat the monsters inside Orbis Tower and bring me #b20 #t4000083# items, 20 #t4000063# items, and 20 #t4000085# items#k. ...Please.
